verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at planetscale.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an LLM-oriented product summary. The docs also offer per-section LLM bundles (_llms/postgres.md, _llms/api-reference.md), markdown versions of pages (.md URLs), and a dedicated agents guide covering the hosted MCP server and skills. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and the root docs.md path returns 404.
